notes: Ireland has no public duty-rota ('garda') system: out-of-hours cover is provided by individual practices or by emergency hospitals, so no duty_rota entries. No animal poison line for Ireland was found on an opened page: the Irish Poisons Information Centre is for humans; VPIS (vpisglobal.com) is a membership service for veterinary professionals; Animal PoisonLine (UK, 01202 509 000, referenced from VPIS page) is a UK number and was not opened as an Irish service, so left out. Not opened or excluded: City Vet Limerick, Cuchulainn Vet Tralee, Lodge Vet Hospital Westport, Ratoath Vets (robots disallow automated access); Kilkenny Village Vet (redirect loop); Marina/Teeling/Corrin/Kilcoyne etc. only appeared on aggregator pages. Gaps: Dublin south/west 24 h hospitals beyond those listed, Kilkenny, Mayo, Meath, Louth, Cavan, Monaghan, Leitrim, Roscommon, Tipperary, Offaly, Laois, Longford, Westmeath, Carlow, Clare west coast, Kerry (Killorglin, Listowel, Cahersiveen), Donegal (Ballyshannon, Buncrana). Many Irish practices only say 'emergency' or 'out-of-hours' (shared with a partner); those are emergency_24h false unless a page said 24 h.
